userRole: 你是使用 Codex 交付 CommerceCommand 的初级工程师。每轮只推进一个真实开发目标，可以询问模块职责、接口、状态、数据流、并发边界和验证证据，但绝不提供代码、命令、SQL、库选择、并发实现、Debug 原因、修复提示、隐藏测试或未来需求。是否进入下一阶段由可见交付证据决定，不因轮数自动前进。

scenes.title: Plan
scenes.objective: Read the complete V1 contract and plan without edits.
scenes.advanceGate: Plan covers the coherent commerce flow, risks, staged delivery, and verification.
scenes.safeMessage: 先完整阅读 README.md 和 AGENTS.md，不修改文件。请给出分阶段计划、关键不变量、主要风险和每阶段验证方式。

scenes.title: Domain language
scenes.objective: Explain canonical entities and invariants.
scenes.advanceGate: Money, inventory, state, identity, and tenant terms are unambiguous.
scenes.safeMessage: 请用白话解释 OfferVersion、Order、Hold、PaymentAttempt、Fulfillment、Entitlement、Ledger、Event、Work 和 Notification 的关系与守恒式。

scenes.title: Architecture
scenes.objective: Define module and process ownership.
scenes.advanceGate: API, transactions, Worker, dispatcher, UI, and PostgreSQL authorities are clear.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 API、领域层、持久化、Worker、dispatcher、PostgreSQL 和 UI 的职责、依赖方向及跨进程 authority。

scenes.title: Success and failure flow
scenes.objective: Trace complete success, rejection, and unknown-response flows.
scenes.advanceGate: Every atomic effect and forbidden side effect is identified.
scenes.safeMessage: 请分别说明 mixed quote 成功、库存不足、支付 UNKNOWN、capture 和 refund 的完整数据流与事务边界。

scenes.title: Public contracts
scenes.objective: Author OpenAPI, states, errors, idempotency, Work, Events, and snapshot contracts.
scenes.advanceGate: Contracts cover every V1 route and observable rule.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成 OpenAPI、输入输出、状态机、错误、幂等、Work、Event、seed 和 verification snapshot 契约，本轮不实现业务。

scenes.title: Test strategy
scenes.objective: Define non-overlapping realistic verification layers.
scenes.advanceGate: Each test layer proves distinct failures and published performance conditions.
scenes.safeMessage: 请说明 Unit、真实 PostgreSQL Integration、production Chromium、Concurrency、Barrier/SIGKILL Recovery 和 Performance 分别验证什么。

scenes.title: Production skeleton
scenes.objective: Build the smallest real runnable architecture.
scenes.advanceGate: API, Worker, dispatcher, UI, build, and health boot independently.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现最小真实 TypeScript、React、PostgreSQL、API、Worker 和 dispatcher 骨架，运行 build 与各角色 smoke。

scenes.title: Migration and seed
scenes.objective: Implement repeatable schema bootstrap and atomic strict seed.
scenes.advanceGate: Valid import, exact replay, conflict, invalid reference, and full rollback are verified.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 migration 和 strict seed，验证重复 migration、合法导入、同版本同正文重放、冲突、跨 tenant 引用和整批回滚。

scenes.title: Immutable offers
scenes.objective: Implement Product and immutable OfferVersion lifecycle.
scenes.advanceGate: Version monotonicity and historical immutability pass real tests.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 Product 与 OfferVersion，验证版本单调、引用后不可变、有效期边界和新版本不改历史订单。

scenes.title: Frozen quote
scenes.objective: Implement atomic mixed quote creation.
scenes.advanceGate: Order, lines, totals, holds, event, notification, and expiry Work commit together.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 mixed physical/digital quote 和冻结 totals，验证成功写入与库存不足的全有或全无。

scenes.title: Inventory contention
scenes.objective: Prove deterministic multi-pool conservation across APIs.
scenes.advanceGate: Hot contention produces legal rejection without drift or oversell.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 pool 选择、split hold、consume/release/expire，并用两个 API 做热库存竞争和守恒重算。

scenes.title: Durable idempotency
scenes.objective: Implement canonical persistent request replay.
scenes.advanceGate: Lost response, concurrent first use, conflict, restart, and malformed JSON behavior pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成持久幂等，真实验证响应丢失、20 路同 key、不同正文冲突、API 重启和 malformed JSON。

scenes.title: Checkout uncertainty
scenes.objective: Implement checkout and UNKNOWN PaymentAttempt.
scenes.advanceGate: One provider request exists and UNKNOWN remains safely recoverable.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 checkout、providerRequest identity、UNKNOWN 状态和 reconciliation Work，验证超时不会二次发起支付。

scenes.title: Payment convergence
scenes.objective: Implement callbacks and reconcile precedence.
scenes.advanceGate: Duplicate and out-of-order outcomes create at most one capture and one financial transition.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 callback/reconcile 去重与 CAPTURED 优先收敛，运行乱序、duplicate、providerEvent conflict 和跨 API 竞争。

scenes.title: Fulfillment lease
scenes.objective: Implement physical FulfillmentPlan and fenced Work.
scenes.advanceGate: Multiple Workers and claim-time SIGKILL still complete each plan once.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 FulfillmentPlan、lease、fencing 和 terminal effect，并用多 Worker 与 claim 后 SIGKILL 验证恢复。

scenes.title: Digital entitlement
scenes.objective: Implement grant and terminal revoke convergence.
scenes.advanceGate: Capture/refund/revoke races cannot leave invalid active rights.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 EntitlementGrant 与 revoke，验证 grant、full refund 和显式 revoke 并发后最终状态及事件唯一性。

scenes.title: Ledger
scenes.objective: Implement immutable balanced journals.
scenes.advanceGate: Capture/refund journals balance by tenant/journal/currency and replay adds no entries.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 append-only LedgerEntry 和 reversing journal，验证每个 journal 平衡、金额边界、并发 refund 与 replay。

scenes.title: Notifications
scenes.objective: Implement transactional ordered outbox dispatch.
scenes.advanceGate: Unknown ACK retry preserves identity/body and another Order is not blocked.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 NotificationDelivery、per-Order sequence 和 dispatcher，运行 response barrier 后 SIGKILL 与 byte-identical retry。

scenes.title: Production UI
scenes.objective: Complete the real V1 browser experience.
scenes.advanceGate: Visible mixed-order, unknown payment, fulfillment, refund, reload, and errors pass Chromium.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成真实商品、quote、checkout、UNKNOWN reconcile、fulfillment/entitlement、refund、ledger 和 notification UI，并跑 production Chromium。

scenes.title: V1 concurrency and recovery
scenes.objective: Exercise the complete V1 under process failures.
scenes.advanceGate: Two APIs, multiple workers/dispatchers, barriers, restarts, and invariant recomputation pass.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行 V1 双 API、多 Worker、双 dispatcher、库存/支付/refund 竞争、两个 Barrier SIGKILL 和负载后全量不变量重算。

scenes.title: V1 review
scenes.objective: Perform findings-first V1 review before accepting a change.
scenes.advanceGate: No material V1 finding remains and evidence is accurate.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做 V1 findings-first Review，重点检查金额、库存、tenant、幂等、lease、事件、通知、测试真实性和未运行项。

scenes.title: Manager marketplace change
scenes.objective: Publish and plan the one compatible scope change without coding.
scenes.advanceGate: Impact plan covers schema, invariants, migration, API, Worker, UI, tests, and performance before edits.
scenes.fixedMessage: 【Commerce Manager】把单商家交易升级为 marketplace 分账与结算。一个 Order 可有多个 Seller；新增 immutable SellerAllocation，POST /api/v1/orders/:orderId/seller-allocations 接受 {allocations:[{orderLineId,sellerId,quantity,amountMinor}]}，每条 line 数量和金额必须完整守恒、同 tenant、首次提交后不可变、并发只能一个合法集合，进入履约后不得重分。新增 SellerSettlement：POST /api/v1/seller-settlements 接受 {tenantId,sellerId,periodStart,periodEnd,currency}，POST /api/v1/seller-settlements/:sellerSettlementId/close 接受 {}；它冻结 eligible allocation、fee、refund reserve、dispute reserve 和净额，CLOSED 不可改写。新增 CommerceDispute：POST /api/v1/commerce-disputes 接受 {tenantId,paymentAttemptId,providerDisputeId,amountMinor}，POST /api/v1/commerce-disputes/:commerceDisputeId/resolve 接受 {providerEventId,outcome:WON|LOST}；refund + dispute reserve 不得超过 captured amount，LOST 只产生一次平衡 chargeback，WON 只释放 reserve。CLOSED 后 correction 只能通过 POST /api/v1/settlement-adjustments {tenantId,sellerId,sourceSettlementId,sourceAllocationId,amountMinor,reason} 写入下一开放周期；SettlementAdjustment 必须持久化 targetPeriodStart，且 targetPeriodStart >= source settlement.periodEnd。新增 SELLER_SETTLEMENT_CLOSE、DISPUTE_RECONCILIATION、SETTLEMENT_ADJUSTMENT Work。所有 mutation 继续要求 Idempotency-Key；非法守恒返回 409 ALLOCATION_NOT_CONSERVED，超额 reserve 返回 409 RESERVE_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE，关闭后改写返回 409 SETTLEMENT_CLOSED。迁移保留全部 V1 ID、实体、Event、Work、通知和 replay，V1 客户端继续工作。保留 V1 七条性能场景并新增：Scenario 'seller-settlement-close' 使用 50,000 eligible allocation、64 并发 60 秒，至少 80 settlement/s、p95<=750ms；Scenario 'refund-dispute-race' 使用 20,000 captured order、64 并发 60 秒，至少 100 mutation/s、p95<=750ms；Scenario 'full-catastrophe-recovery' 预装 10,000 mixed entities，持续负载时 SIGKILL API、Worker、dispatcher，300 秒内 drain 并保持全部 V1 与 marketplace 不变量。更新 OpenAPI、UI、seed、snapshot、各测试层。本轮只做影响分析和计划，不要编码。
scenes.safeMessage: 请先分析 marketplace 变更对 schema、状态、事务、迁移、Worker、UI、测试和性能的影响，不要编码。

scenes.title: Compatible manager migration
scenes.objective: Add marketplace schema without rewriting V1 state.
scenes.advanceGate: V1 IDs, payloads, Work, Events, replay, and old client requests remain exact.
scenes.safeMessage: 请先完成兼容 migration 和 versioned Work，验证 V1 数据、saved replay、旧 API binary 与旧客户端都不变。

scenes.title: Seller allocation
scenes.objective: Implement immutable conserved seller allocation.
scenes.advanceGate: Invalid split rolls back and two-API valid split commits one exact set.
scenes.safeMessage: 请实现 SellerAllocation，验证少 1 minor、数量错误、跨 tenant、履约后重分、同 key replay 和双 API 并发。

scenes.title: Settlement close
scenes.objective: Implement captured settlement and close fencing.
scenes.advanceGate: Eligible allocations enter at most one immutable CLOSED settlement under race.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 SellerSettlement 金额/reserve 冻结和 close，用两个 API 并发关闭并验证 allocation 不重复归属。

scenes.title: Dispute reserve
scenes.objective: Implement dispute lifecycle and refund reservation conservation.
scenes.advanceGate: Refund/open/resolve races respect capture and LOST/WON effects occur once.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 CommerceDispute、reserve、WON/LOST 和 chargeback，运行 refund/open/resolve 乱序与并发守恒。

scenes.title: Post-close adjustment
scenes.objective: Implement next-period immutable correction.
scenes.advanceGate: Closed settlement never changes and correction replays once in an open period.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 SettlementAdjustment，验证 CLOSED 后 refund/chargeback/correction 只追加下一周期且引用链完整。

scenes.title: Marketplace UI
scenes.objective: Extend the real UI without regressing V1.
scenes.advanceGate: Allocation, settlement, dispute, adjustment, and old V1 journeys pass production Chromium.
scenes.safeMessage: 请完成 allocation、settlement close、dispute resolution、adjustment UI 和错误态，并重跑旧 V1 浏览器旅程。

scenes.title: Catastrophe and blue-green
scenes.objective: Verify combined recovery and rolling compatibility.
scenes.advanceGate: Old/new binaries, multiple roles, mixed state, and three SIGKILLs converge without invariant loss.
scenes.safeMessage: 请运行 blue-green 兼容、V1 replay、mixed marketplace state、API/Worker/dispatcher SIGKILL 和替代进程 drain。

scenes.title: Ten performance scenarios
scenes.objective: Run every fixed sustained scenario at scoring scale.
scenes.advanceGate: All ten thresholds and post-load invariants pass with real metrics.
scenes.safeMessage: 请用 BENCH_PERF_SCALE=1 运行十条正式性能场景，逐条报告吞吐、p95、状态、drain、进程失败和负载后不变量。

scenes.title: Final code review
scenes.objective: Perform a strict findings-first review and fix evidence-backed defects.
scenes.advanceGate: No material correctness, security, recovery, compatibility, or test-quality finding remains.
scenes.safeMessage: 请做最终 findings-first Code Review，优先检查金额/库存守恒、tenant、迁移、lease/fence、outbox、测试真实性和过度复杂代码。

scenes.title: Final handoff
scenes.objective: Provide an accurate reproducible delivery handoff.
scenes.advanceGate: Handoff states architecture, commands, actual results, metrics, risks, and omissions accurately.
scenes.safeMessage: 请给出最终交付：架构与数据流、关键不变量、migration、真实命令和结果、十条指标、已修复 findings、剩余风险及未运行项。
